project.name: Numou Finance - Syirkah (Islamic partnership accounting)
project.description: Syirkah (inan, abdan, mudharabah, wujuh, mufawadhah) accounting following hukum muamalah: nisbah-based profit sharing on net profit, capital-proportional loss, period close with immutable hashed snapshots, append-only partner movements, capital revisions via new akad, liquidation and correction.
